text: Standing between probe console and helm chair, facing the comms monitor: prompt says 'E Use the helm console' while the crosshair sits on the COMMS monitor's screen (comms is 3 m away at +10 deg, helm 1 m at -4 deg). A player would expect E to open comms.

At the helm console, two Discovery toasts (Metronome, Called it) are drawn on top of the Helm panel's description text, making both unreadable. Also: pressing Return in walk mode opened the helm console (Return acts like E).

Spacetime map console open: a centred hint 'Optional: the spacetime map is on th...' is clipped by the right-hand panel (text runs under the panel). Objective box at top-left also gone (objective 2 completed at tick 7164 while walking here, no new objective shown yet).

Recall beam: first click on 'Fire recall beam' (992,198, where the button was in the last screenshot) did nothing because the panel had scrolled and the sticky fire bar jumped up to y~157; second click at 157 fired (panel: 'Beam fired 44 s after her mayday, 5 s before the deadline') but the button still read 'Fire recall beam' for ~1 game second after the click, and a follow-up hold on it did nothing visible. Objective 4 not ticked at the moment of firing (still open at tick 12527).
